headline: Launcher v0.10.0 released with online co-op for Ratchet & Clank
summary: Launcher v0.10.0 is out through the stable line’s release pull request (#116). With the Multiplayer mod, players share a Ratchet & Clank campaign, see each other’s Ratchet, share broken crates and collected bolts, and travel between planets together (#99). The release also brings enhanced rendering with environment reflections and playable lighting-probe placement (#119).
highlights: The level editor gains one status panel, plain error messages and an Update project that carries edits into refreshed projects (#107).
Creator-authored PAL destinations can be installed without replacing campaign planets, and authored terrain can import static scenery from other levels (#104).
Typed object-property edits survive installed builds without source headers (#100). The launcher also offers confirmed editor reset and level reread actions (#105).
Optional fresh controller input and low-latency frames arrive in the port (#122). Exit and the player’s language survive Quit Game (#126).
SDK 1.10.1 adds Android native-mod support (#117, #118). Persistent Ratchet & Clank savestates also land (#103).
The Development channel now follows develop, so its builds no longer wait for stable releases (#111).
